AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
At 6:00 PM, and 6:15 PM, City Clerk Liza Tamura announced that at the City Council Regular Meeting of May 6, 2025, City Manager Talyn Mirzakhanian, announced that the July 1, 2025, City Council Regular Meeting was cancelled.  

City Clerk Tamura adjourned the July 1, 2025, City Council Regular Meeting to an Adjourned Regular Meeting on Monday, July 14, 2025, at 4:00 PM, in the City Council Chambers.
